Advocate for the Respondent : ,
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Robin Phukan
 Order
Date : 09.06.2025
Heard Mr. R. Goswami, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor vehicles Act, 1988, is directed against the Judgment and award dated 07.03.2025, passed by the learned Member, MACT No.2, Kamrup (M) in MAC Case No. 463/2022,
field under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgement and award dated 07.03.2025, the learned tribunal has directed the appellant/insurance company to pay a sum of Rs. 3,78,262/- being compensation with interest at the rate of 9% per annum from the date of filing the claim petition till its realisation.
Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein.
Admit.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable in 4 (four) weeks.
Step be taken upon respondents by registered post with A/D as well as usual process within a week from today.
Registry shall call for the records from the learned Tribunal.
List the matter after 4 (four) weeks.
